title: “I followed what felt right, not what I was told”: Autonomy, Coaching, and Recognizing Bias Through AI-Mediated Dialogue
reasoning: The paper investigates how AI coaching influences human moral and social judgments regarding ableist microaggressions. It explicitly discusses concepts such as 'moral scaffolds', 'moral agency', 'moral reasoning', and 'normative judgments' as central to how users interact with, adopt, or resist AI-mediated social suggestions.
